topic: Rootless n8n trading pipeline on a sudo-less office box
facts: Host had no root/sudo - rootless Docker 29.8.1 assembled from static binaries inside a single-uid user namespace (unshare -Ur)
Outbound NAT via slirp4netns; inbound forwarding via self-written port_fwd.py since --bridge=none
n8n 2.41.3, Node 24.21.0 via nvm, localtunnel 2.0.2 for the TradingView webhook
Order math fully deterministic in a JS Code node: LIMIT=(POC+OB)/2, SL=OB-offset, QTY=floor(risk/(limit-stop)*100)/100 - the LLM never computes numbers
Fixed risk per setup: 100 USDT, limit-only entries inside the stop pool
OpenRouter free tier: 50 requests/day, responses 15-120 s, retry up to 3-4 min under rate limit
LLM fallback chain of 3 free models after meta-llama/llama-3-8b-instruct:free returned 404 'No endpoints found'
Bybit account-ratio API polled at period=5min for live long/short sentiment

arc.plan: TradingView Smart Money alert -> ready-made order verdict on the phone
arc.attempt: LLM in the loop for the audit line on top of the n8n pipeline
arc.failure: Pinned model deleted from OpenRouter (404); TradingView JSON template broke twice on unescaped quotes and unsupported placeholders
arc.fix: 3-model fallback cascade + deterministic JS for all math, LLM reduced to one audit line with onError fallback
arc.outcome: Pipeline live on office PC; LLM hallucinations in numbers excluded by construction

forbidden_claims: Any profit/win-rate figures - none were measured
Public tunnel URL, chat_id, tokens, home paths
author_notes: Lead with the no-sudo constraint - it is the most relatable pain. Keep the 'math taken away from the LLM' decision central; that is the engineering takeaway.
